about: Hand-computed from mini-set.json, retrievals.json and judge-verdicts.jsonl; arithmetic in README.md. recall@k = |gold chunks covered by sourceChunkIds of non-summary items in ranks 1..k| / |gold|, averaged over questions. Summaries are scored separately (withSummaries). Floats are exact fractions: 2/3 and 5/6 compare with a tolerance of 1e-9.

traps.perItemRecall: counting gold item IDs among the top k instead of covered gold chunks gives q4 recall@1 = 0 (the relation is not a gold chunk) instead of 0.5
traps.duplicateText: q4: entropy/2.1-d1 has the same text as gold entropy/2.1-d0 but a different chunk ID; it must not count
traps.summaryInflation: q5: counting the summary's sources gives recall@1 = 1; chunk recall must give 0
traps.partialMultiHop: q3 gets one of two gold chunks: 0.5, not 0 and not 1
